card.name: Linking words before condition descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (called, like, with, by, of, a) right after a named infection or disease, such as conjunctivitis, chlamydia or bowel obstruction, where a cause, complication or description comes next.

modes.label: Linking word after eye infection
modes.description: Words like called, like or with right after conjunctivitis or pinkeye wording.
modes.example: Sounds<< like>> conjunctivitis, sometimes called pin

modes.label: Link word in disease headings
modes.description: Words such as of, by or a in phrases about a diagnosis, prevention or cause.
modes.example: Prevention<< of>> bowel obstruction depends on the cause.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words like complications and complicated, plus their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words after an infection or disease name, when the text is about to describe its causes or complications.
